deadline_local.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or INCONNU when missing

deadline_tz.description: IANA timezone of the source deadline, or INCONNU when missing

team_tz.description: IANA timezone of the team doing the work, when the source states it. Distinct from deadline_tz. Omit the key when unstated.

bid_effort_hours.description: Stated hours to prepare the bid. Not elapsed time until the deadline. Omit the key when unstated.

capacity_hours.description: Stated team hours available before the deadline. Not elapsed wall-clock hours. Omit the key when unstated.
